reason: I do tickets and turns on paper and pay my techs from a notebook, and it works. My bank terminal is cheap, so $49 a month plus a $299 reader is real money before I see any benefit.
objection: My current POS is only $40, why pay $49? Plus $299 for a reader I have to buy, and I don't know if it will break on a busy Saturday or if the techs will get angry about seeing their tips.
would_change_my_mind: Price at $30 or less, or the reader free or very cheap, plus a salon I know in the Facebook group telling me it works and they set it up for me with no stress.
